name: burnished_hart_up_to_two_takes_one
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Search your library for up to two basic land cards, put them onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.' 'Up to two': with two basic lands in the library seat 0 may stop after one (CR 107.1c). Seat 0 picks the Island and stops: the Island alone enters tapped, the Forest stays in the library.
